name: Mifeng Xiaoying
source:
A righteous but depressed young man fancifully strayed into the world of bees and led his soul to salvation for lifetime.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970300/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个正义却郁闷的年轻人幻想误入蜜蜂的世界，带领自己的灵魂得到了一生的救赎。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970300/]Steam[/url]]
